data.why: The Batch Prediction tab needs a CSV with mirna/target columns to upload; one clean file mirrors the README's real miRNA-target pairs (also used as single-prediction examples), the other adds a missing target and an invalid base to exercise the app's per-row validation errors.

goals: Score a specific candidate miRNA-target pair for interaction probability before committing to wet-lab validation
Check a known negative control pair to confirm the model correctly scores it as non-interacting
Batch-score a CSV of many candidate miRNA-target pairs and download ranked results
Confirm the app rejects malformed or out-of-range sequences (wrong length, non-ACGU/T characters, missing field) instead of silently scoring garbage
Review the model's architecture and benchmark performance (AUROC, APS) to judge whether it's suitable for a given target-prediction task

review.summary: The tree has the right shape: a hypothesis-screening goal, then single-pair scoring, batch scoring and model review. The labels and the screens I opened mostly match it. However, the model never returned a score in this run, so the central output (probability and call, annotated CSV, validation messages) has no evidence, and one phase goes to generic Gradio run history; it needs a re-run with the model pre-loaded and the listed fixes before filing.
